blocker_rule: Any verified defect that can misstate medication name, amount, concentration, or dose unit remains In progress with High priority and blocks release closure until a verified fix and clinical validation are recorded.
release_gate_rule: When any blocker is unresolved, set the release-gate work package to In progress with High priority and add a comment naming the blocking work package subject and evidence reference.
forbidden_shortcut: A mobile-interface component label or cosmetic similarity cannot downgrade a medication-information defect.
